title: A simple residue root over a henselian-ring colimit lifts at a stage
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty small directed poset and $(A_i,u_{ij})_{i\le j}$ a direct system of commutative henselian local rings [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_i$ and local transition maps $u_{ij}^{-1}(\mathfrak m_j)=\mathfrak m_i$. Let $(A,(\alpha_i))$ be a colimit in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and assume $A$ is local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and $\alpha_i^{-1}(\mathfrak m)=\mathfrak m_i$. Put $k_i=A_i/\mathfrak m_i$, $k=A/\mathfrak m$, and $\rho_i([x])=[\alpha_i(x)]$. Assume $(k,(\rho_i))$ is the ring colimit of the induced residue-field diagram. For any monic $f\in A[T]$ of degree $n$ and $a_0\in k$ with $\overline f(a_0)=0$ and $\overline{f'}(a_0)\ne0$, there exist $i\in I$, a monic $f_i\in A_i[T]$ of degree $n$, $a_{0,i}\in k_i$, and $a_i\in A_i$ such that $\alpha_i[T](f_i)=f$, $\rho_i(a_{0,i})=a_0$, $\overline{f_i}(a_{0,i})=0$, $\overline{f_i'}(a_{0,i})\ne0$, $f_i(a_i)=0$, and $a_i\bmod\mathfrak m_i=a_{0,i}$. Here bars mean coefficientwise reduction, $\alpha_i[T]$ means coefficientwise application of $\alpha_i$, and the formal derivative of $\sum_j c_jT^j$ is $\sum_{j\ge1}jc_jT^{j-1}$.

proof.text: If $n=0$, monicity gives $f=1$, whose reduction has no root in the field $k$; hence the hypotheses force $n>0$. Write $f=T^n+\sum_{r<n}c_rT^r$.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, proof: monic polynomial, simple residue root, and stage solution.

proof.text: Apply [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data] to the finite list $(c_r)_{r<n}$ in the commutative-ring colimit $A$, with no equations imposed. It gives a stage $p$ and $b_r\in A_p$ with $\alpha_p(b_r)=c_r$. Put $g_p=T^n+\sum_{r<n}b_rT^r$. Its leading coefficient is $1$, so it is monic of degree $n$ (the maximal ideal of $A_p$ is proper, so $1\ne0$), and coefficientwise $\alpha_p[T](g_p)=f$.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, proof: monic polynomial, simple residue root, and stage solution.

proof.text: The nonempty small directed poset $I$ is filtered: two objects have an upper bound and parallel arrows are equal. Apply clause (1) of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise] to the assumed commutative-ring colimit $k=\varinjlim k_j$. Obtain $q$ and $b\in k_q$ with $\rho_q(b)=a_0$. Choose $i\ge p,q$ by directedness. Let $f_i=u_{pi}[T](g_p)$ and $a_{0,i}=\overline u_{qi}(b)$, where $\overline u_{qi}([x])=[u_{qi}(x)]$ is well-defined since transitions carry maximal ideals into maximal ideals. Its coefficients are $d_r=u_{pi}(b_r)$ below degree $n$ and $1$ in degree $n$, so $f_i$ is monic of degree $n$. The cocone equalities give $\alpha_i(d_r)=c_r$ and $\rho_i(a_{0,i})=\rho_q(b)=a_0$. Thus $\alpha_i[T](f_i)=f$.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, proof: monic polynomial, simple residue root, and stage solution.

proof.text: The map $\rho_i$ reflects zero: if $z=[x]\in k_i$ satisfies $\rho_i(z)=0$, then $\alpha_i(x)\in\mathfrak m$, hence $x\in\mathfrak m_i$ by the assumed equality $\alpha_i^{-1}(\mathfrak m)=\mathfrak m_i$, and $z=0$. Set $d_n=1$ and $c_n=1$. Expanding finite sums and using preservation of addition, multiplication, $1$ and integer multiples gives $\rho_i(\sum_{r=0}^n[d_r]a_{0,i}^r)=\sum_{r=0}^n[c_r]a_0^r=\overline f(a_0)=0$ and $\rho_i(\sum_{r=1}^n r[d_r]a_{0,i}^{r-1})=\sum_{r=1}^n r[c_r]a_0^{r-1}=\overline{f\prime}(a_0)\ne0$. The first sum is $\overline{f_i}(a_{0,i})$, so zero reflection makes it zero. The second is $\overline{f_i\prime}(a_{0,i})$; it cannot be zero because a ring homomorphism sends zero to zero. These are precisely the two simple-root conditions at stage $i$.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, proof: monic polynomial, simple residue root, and stage solution.

proof.text: Apply implication (i)$\Rightarrow$(ii) of [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-local-root-lifting] to the henselian local ring $A_i$, the monic polynomial $f_i$, and the residue root $a_{0,i}$ with the two conditions proved above. It supplies $a_i\in A_i$ satisfying $f_i(a_i)=0$ and $a_i\bmod\mathfrak m_i=a_{0,i}$. Together with the equalities of step 3 and the conditions of step 4 these give every asserted clause.

lean.statement: theorem exists_monic_simple_root_stage {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, HenselianLocalRing (F.obj i)] (hlocal : ∀ (i j : I) (hij : i ≤ j), (maximalIdeal (F.obj j)).comap (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom = maximalIdeal (F.obj i)) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c) [IsLocalRing c.pt] (hlegs : ∀ i : I, (maximalIdeal c.pt).comap (c.ι.app i).hom = maximalIdeal (F.obj i)) (ρ : ∀ i : I, ResidueField (F.obj i) →+* ResidueField c.pt) (hρ : ∀ (i : I) (x : F.obj i), ρ i (residue (F.obj i) x) = residue c.pt (c.ι.app i x)) (hrescolim : ∀ (B : CommRingCat.{u}) (β : ∀ i : I, ResidueField (F.obj i) →+* B), (∀ (i j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (x : F.obj i), β j (residue (F.obj j) (F.map (homOfLE hij) x)) = β i (residue (F.obj i) x)) → ∃! g : ResidueField c.pt →+* B, ∀ i : I, g.comp (ρ i) = β i) (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial c.pt) (hf : f.Monic) (hdegree : f.natDegree = n) (a₀ : ResidueField c.pt) (hroot : (f.map (residue c.pt)).eval a₀ = 0) (hsimple : (f.derivative.map (residue c.pt)).eval a₀ ≠ 0) : ∃ (i : I) (fᵢ : Polynomial (F.obj i)) (a₀ᵢ : ResidueField (F.obj i)) (aᵢ : F.obj i), fᵢ.Monic ∧ fᵢ.natDegree = n ∧ fᵢ.map (c.ι.app i).hom = f ∧ ρ i a₀ᵢ = a₀ ∧ (fᵢ.map (residue (F.obj i))).eval a₀ᵢ = 0 ∧ (fᵢ.derivative.map (residue (F.obj i))).eval a₀ᵢ ≠ 0 ∧ fᵢ.eval aᵢ = 0 ∧ residue (F.obj i) aᵢ = a₀ᵢ
